title: Gabe Newell: Reflections of a Video Game Maker
summary: Gabe Newell, founder of Valve, gives a talk at the LBJ School on productivity, economics, political institutions and the future of corporations. He discusses Valve's hiring and pay, its flat structure and an open-office anecdote.
why: HN cites it for how Valve works: hiring unconventional talent, paying by value, firing as aggressively as hiring, and why open offices fail.

quote.text: This is all reminiscent of the talk Gabe Newell, CEO and founder of Valve, gave on the hiring practices at Valve.
